calculation_handling.description: Points to the additional lot requirements found in each zone of the Residential Zone category; no value is computed.

No townhouse or apartment building may be erected or used on a lot abutting a major street unless the municipal water mains and sewers have adequate capacity, to the satisfaction of the General Manager, Toronto Water.
calculation_handling.gaps: Water and sewer capacity is a municipal determination, not held in the lot data.

calculation_handling.description: The water main and sewer capacity requirement does not apply to a townhouse or apartment building if the lot will contain 10 or fewer dwelling units, dwelling rooms or bed-sitting rooms.
calculation_handling.gaps: The capacity requirement it exempts from is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The water main and sewer capacity requirement does not apply to an addition of less than 50 square metres of gross floor area to a lawfully existing building on a lot with no more than 10 dwelling units, dwelling rooms and bed-sitting rooms.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the addition size and as-built building facts.

calculation_handling.description: The water main and sewer capacity requirement does not apply to replacing or reconstructing a building damaged by fire, explosion, flood or similar cause, or due to a City order, if gross floor area and height are not increased, no setback is reduced and the use is unchanged.

10.5.30.1(1).explanation: Each zone in the Residential Zone category sets its own additional lot requirements.

10.5.30.1(2).explanation: On a lot that abuts a major street, a townhouse or apartment building can only be built or used if the municipal water mains and sewers have adequate capacity, to the satisfaction of the General Manager, Toronto Water.

10.5.30.1(3).explanation: The water and sewer capacity requirement does not apply to a townhouse or apartment building on a lot with 10 or fewer dwelling units, rooms or bed-sitting rooms; to an addition under 50 square metres on such a lot; or to rebuilding after fire, flood or a City order without enlarging or reducing setbacks.
